visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged man with short hair and glasses, wearing a black button-down shirt, stands centrally in front of a digital night skyline of Taipei, featuring the Taipei 101 building clearly in the background. He speaks expressively, using frequent hand gestures to emphasize points. (2) A series of graphic overlays appear, first a stylized map of Japan and Taiwan with cherry blossom illustrations, then a detailed nautical map showing the Kuroshio current paths with circular blue arrows. (3) A 3x4 grid collage of nine photographs displays the construction of a dugout canoe: a tall cedar tree, a man using a stone axe, the hollowing of the log, and the finished boat on a beach. (4) Documentary-style video footage shows a group of five individuals rowing a narrow wooden dugout canoe through open, choppy seawater under an overcast sky. (5) The man returns to the center frame against the Taipei skyline, holding a black remote and gesturing with his right hand as he concludes the presentation.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: 三萬年前台灣人如何赴日遊. [Subtitle]: 你是不是只要一打開社群媒體. (2) [Subtitle]: 就看到朋友又去日本玩了. (3) [Subtitle]: 蛤 沒有朋友 都是看網紅在玩. (4) [Subtitle]: 現在很多台灣人去日本玩. (5) [Subtitle]: 就像在行灶跤 (kiânn-tsàu-kha). (6) [Subtitle]: 很多證據顯示這樣的旅行可能早在三萬多年前就開始了. (7) [Subtitle]: 但科學家一直沒辦法確認當時的台灣人到底是怎麼去日本的. (8) [Subtitle]: 日本東京大學綜合研究博物館教授海部陽介團隊. (9) [Slogan]: Science Advances. [Subtitle]: 發布了最終的兩篇論文. (10) [Subtitle]: 公布了航行實驗的完整故事. (11) [Subtitle]: 為什麼科學家會鎖定台灣當作起點.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: Middle-aged Asian male, short dark hair, black rectangular glasses, wearing a black long-sleeved button-down shirt.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: Primary background is a digital composite of the Taipei city skyline at night with Taipei 101. Inserted footage shows a workshop area with trees, a sandy beach, and the open dark blue ocean.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Energetic male narration begins immediately with a high speech rate and clear articulation. The background music features a driving electronic beat and bright synth pads at 128 BPM. (2) A synthesized 'whoosh' sound effect triggers a change in acoustic phase as the speaker introduces the scientific context. (3) The narration continues with high emotional arousal; a melodic 'ding' sound effect emphasizes the mention of the Science Advances journal. (4) Ambient textures of water splashing and low-frequency wind noise are mixed under the narration during the rowing sequence, accompanied by percussive thudding sounds. (5) The master track returns to a clean studio profile with the narrator delivering a rapid-fire summary over the sustained rhythmic background music.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Hypothesis -> Experimental Process -> Results -> Conclusion
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to educate viewers on a specific archaeological experiment that tested the possibility of prehistoric migration from Taiwan to Japan. It details the construction of a primitive dugout canoe and the successful 2019 expedition to cross the Kuroshio current to prove ancient human navigation capabilities.

high_inference.freeDescribe: A fast-paced popular science video using standard social-media editing techniques to make historical and archaeological data accessible.
